record.label: Capped energies and the 1 mHa RMS bound
record.statement: The authors require a root-mean-square (RMS) error of at most 1 mHa at the cutoff 0.1 Ha above the 63-electron ground-state energy. Equation (20) caps the true and estimated energies before taking their difference.
record.boundary: For an eigenstate 5 mHa above the cutoff, an estimate 3 mHa above it has zero capped error. An estimate 2 mHa below the cutoff gives a shortfall of 2 mHa. If this occurs with probability 1/4 and all other outcomes have zero capped error, the RMS shortfall is 1 mHa. Below the cutoff the true energy retains its value.
